description: Traditional palm mounts catalog with MediaPipe anatomical anchors (Spec §49.5, FR-011).

anatomical_anchor.region: Directly below the index finger base on upper radial palm.

prominence_meanings.underdeveloped: Humility, diffidence, self-effacing, prefers supportive or background roles.
prominence_meanings.balanced: Natural dignity, confident leadership, visionary ambition, balanced self-esteem.
prominence_meanings.prominent: Dominant personality, proud, natural commander, strongly ambitious and competitive.

anatomical_anchor.region: Directly beneath the middle finger base.

prominence_meanings.underdeveloped: Lighthearted, carefree, dislikes solitary work, lives for the moment.
prominence_meanings.balanced: Philosophical, disciplined, responsible, ethical, deep thinker with quiet endurance.
prominence_meanings.prominent: Serious, introverted, solitary temperament, intensely studious, highly cautious.

anatomical_anchor.region: Directly below the ring finger base.

prominence_meanings.underdeveloped: Utilitarian mindset, indifferent to arts or aesthetics, grounded in practical necessities.
prominence_meanings.balanced: Refined artistic taste, radiant warmth, optimistic spirit, magnetic social grace.
prominence_meanings.prominent: Extravagant love of beauty, dramatic flair, craving for applause and celebrity spotlight.

anatomical_anchor.region: Directly beneath the little finger base.

prominence_meanings.underdeveloped: Shy in speech, straightforward, prefers simple conversations over negotiation.
prominence_meanings.balanced: Persuasive speaker, sharp intellect, commercial savvy, swift adaptability.
prominence_meanings.prominent: Exceptionally articulate, fast-talking, sharp negotiator, inventive mind.

anatomical_anchor.region: The fleshy ball of the palm enclosed by the Life Line.

prominence_meanings.underdeveloped: Ascetic nature, detached from sensual pleasures, reserved in physical affections.
prominence_meanings.balanced: Warm-hearted, passionate, vibrant vitality, loving, appreciative of music and beauty.
prominence_meanings.prominent: Deeply passionate, hedonistic love of pleasure, abundant physical energy.

anatomical_anchor.region: The fleshy lower percussion on the outer edge of the palm opposite the thumb.

prominence_meanings.underdeveloped: Hyper-realistic, grounded strictly in tangible facts, rare daydreams.
prominence_meanings.balanced: Intuitive insight, vivid imagination, empathetic emotional antenna, artistic flair.
prominence_meanings.prominent: Visionary dreamer, profound mystical sensibilities, poetic, highly receptive to psychic impressions.
